Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

snow — soft white ice falling from the sky. Example: It snows in winter.
winter — the coldest season. Example: In winter it is very cold.
cold — with a low temperature. Example: It is cold today.
ice — frozen water. Example: There is ice on the lake.
snowman — a figure made of snow. Example: The children are making a snowman.
wind — moving air. Example: The wind is strong today.
season — spring, summer, autumn or winter. Example: Winter is my favourite season.
weather — the state of the air outside. Example: What is the weather like?
warm — a little hot. Example: I wear a warm coat.
coat — a warm piece of clothing for outside. Example: I wear a warm coat in winter.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• It is snowing.
• It is very cold.
• I wear a warm coat.
• The children are making a snowman.
• It is my favourite season.
